title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Builder-Delay Waiver Amount
content:
**Clause.** The extension charge waived is the latest extension fee charge on the Builder Extended Rate Lock ledger, and the waiver names that charge number; relock, float-down and program change charges are never waived. The builder-delay waiver is the term's builder-delay waiver percent of the extension charge, rounded half up to the cent, never more than the extension charge itself.

## Elements

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Charge waived | the latest extension fee charge on the lock ledger, by its printed charge number |
| Amount of that charge | as booked on the lock ledger |
| Builder-delay waiver percent | the product's extension figures for the lock's term |
| Ceiling | the amount of the extension charge itself |

## Worked figures (hypothetical ledger, waiver percent 100)

| Extension fee charges on the ledger (oldest first) | Charge waived | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| LCK-CHG-4410 for USD 515.43 | LCK-CHG-4410 | USD 515.43 |
| LCK-CHG-4410 for USD 515.43, then LCK-CHG-4517 for USD 1030.86 | LCK-CHG-4517, the latest | USD 1030.86 |

A relock fee charge or a float-down fee charge on the same ledger is never the charge waived, even when it is the latest charge of any kind.
